rationale.edition: Every changed path in changed_files.txt lives in open-source-owned locations: src/ (api, config, core), web/src/**, tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**, and scripts/. No path is under enterprise/ or o2_enterprise/, and no enterprise keyword (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appears in the changed paths or symbol names. Workflows is now an OSS feature, so this is an oss change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no explicit opt-out (trigger_comment.txt is empty and no tests-added label was passed), and the change is clearly user-facing: it rewrites the Workflows canvas, node drawers, functions picker, and replaces the results dock with a new WorkflowRuns/RunsPanel UI plus a new navbar entry. The existing Playwright specs are modified in the diff, which does not trigger an auto-skip.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff adds/alters many user-facing UI flows under web/src/plugins/workflows/ and web/src/components/workflows/ (new WorkflowStartCard, WorkflowConfigHeader, WorkflowConfigSummary, WorkflowRunSwitcher; deleted WorkflowResultsDock/Panel replaced by WorkflowRuns/WorkflowRunsPanel) plus flow/forms components and a new Data-navbar entry. These need end-to-end verification of building a workflow, configuring nodes, running it, and viewing results.
rationale.area: Workflows. The overwhelming majority of the UI change lives under web/src/plugins/workflows/ and web/src/components/workflows/, and the existing sibling E2E specs live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Workflows/ (workflows-crud.spec.js, workflows-negative.spec.js).
rationale.group: The Workflows matrix shard in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.ent.json is testfolder 'Workflows' (actual_folder 'Workflows') with run_files [workflows-crud.spec.js, workflows-negative.spec.js], so the new spec joins that same group.
rationale.existing_tests: Two Playwright E2E specs are changed in the diff (tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Workflows/workflows-crud.spec.js and workflows-negative.spec.js), but both are modified only to add test.skip(true, 'Workflows feature under rework') — the dev disabled the existing coverage rather than extending it to the reworked feature, so they do not cover the new behavior. The many web/src/**/*.spec.ts files in the diff are Vitest unit tests and are not E2E coverage.
